hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/p' | head -1); BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); CODE=$(printf '%s' "$BR" | grep -oE '^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+'); GD=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$GD" ] && printf '%s' "$CODE" > "$GD/claude-jira-ticket"; if [ -n "$CODE" ]; then LDIR="$HOME/.claude/observability"; mkdir -p "$LDIR"; printf '{"ts":%s,"session":"%s","ticket":"%s","branch":"%s","event":"SessionStart"}\n' "$(date +%s%3N)" "$SID" "$CODE" "$BR" >> "$LDIR/session-tickets.jsonl"; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Active Jira ticket for this session: %s (derived from the current git branch name). Treat %s as the ticket reference for this work - use it when committing, creating branches, and opening PRs."}}' "$CODE" "$CODE"; fi

INPUT=$(cat); SID=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | sed -nE 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"([^"]*)".*/\1/p' | head -1); BR=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); CODE=$(printf '%s' "$BR" | grep -oE '^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+'); GD=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$GD" ] && exit 0; PREV=$(cat "$GD/claude-jira-ticket" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$CODE" != "$PREV" ]; then printf '%s' "$CODE" > "$GD/claude-jira-ticket"; if [ -n "$CODE" ]; then LDIR="$HOME/.claude/observability"; mkdir -p "$LDIR"; printf '{"ts":%s,"session":"%s","ticket":"%s","branch":"%s","event":"BranchChange"}\n' "$(date +%s%3N)" "$SID" "$CODE" "$BR" >> "$LDIR/session-tickets.jsonl"; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Git branch changed - the active Jira ticket is now %s. Use %s as the ticket reference for commits, branches, and PRs from now on."}}' "$CODE" "$CODE"; fi; fi

Use %s as the ticket reference for commits, branches, and PRs."}}' "$CODE" "$CODE"; fi; fi
